title: They charged my card without my permission!!
body:
This app is a SCAM!!
I am frustrated with what has just happened. 
This is the first time I am downloading this APP. I saw good reviews and I said that I’ll give it a try for the 7 days FREE trial period. So I hit the button and they immediately charged me the full amount for the year €43,99!!
With NO free trial. And I had never visited this app again in my life! I am thinking of canceling my card cause this is really strange! 
I sent them an email for the refund and still waiting for their response.
